notes.title: working on upgrade!
notes.content:
hello everyone: 3
I am working on more creatures and expanding the map, I will add new content whenever possible, update 1.0.1 will take a long time since it will have a lot of material, I will try to prepare the option to save and load game. so you can save all your progress in the game and play comfortably.[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EaTtfgmXsAAS0ZZ?format=png&name=900x900[/img]
